scope.purpose: Non-synthesis voice-list metadata diagnostic only, not a synthesis/WSS health-check or audio authorization
scope.method: A separately audited single-GET implementation, not unmodified edge_tts.list_voices() or CLI --list-voices

dns.note: Any DNS performed by runtime/OS/resolver is a distinct outbound operation and must be disclosed; if unable to enforce or count, remain BLOCKED

time.runner_and_window: Must be named in separate owner approval; no standing/recurring authorization

never_capture: full request URL/query or signed parameter values
privacy.policy: In-memory sanitize before any structured log/artifact; redaction failure => no artifact; only high-level result category

proposed_evidence_artifact.contents: Strict privacy.allowlisted_artifact_fields; no body, full URL or packet data

prohibitions: No DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket or TTS in current research phase
No unmodified list_voices due to potential 403-triggered second GET
No redirects, hidden retries, clock skew second GET, alternate hosts, proxy/egress/region bypass or dependency upgrades
No MP3, SRT, WordBoundary, speech synthesis or inference of actual WSS health
No Stage2, render, production, cron, Pages, YouTube or publication
No automatic follow-on execution or implicit permission inheritance

owner_authorization_checklist.item: Exact HTTPS GET host/path, one-attempt budget and 30-second maximum window
DNS resolver/operation count separately specified and approved
Audited one-GET code and absence of hidden retry/redirect verified before use
Runner, UTC execution window and sanitized artifact fields expressly approved
403 immediate stop and secret redaction independently reviewed
